lines.hook: Do you own a business? Imagine having a professional website, like this!
lines.show: This is Zawadi Mart, a live online shop I built. Modern, mobile friendly, and easy to use.
lines.f0: Customers can search and filter products, and find exactly what they want in seconds.
lines.f1: Products are neatly organised by category, with photos, prices and live stock levels.
lines.f2: Shoppers add to cart and check out smoothly, with prices and stock confirmed before they pay.
lines.f3: Payments are built in with Em-Pesa. An S T K push prompt goes straight to the customer's phone.
lines.f4: Customers get their own accounts, with order history and delivery tracking.
lines.f5: And you manage it all from one admin dashboard: orders, products and customers.
lines.pitch: Your business could have a website like this! Custom website development, payment integration, and ongoing technical support.
lines.cta: Let's build your business website! Message me on WhatsApp today, on plus two five four, one one seven, five six one, one nine two.
